historical_fact_gate: CLOSED: issuer Q2 filing explicitly states compliance
debt_basis: Gross Consolidated Total Indebtedness, including capital leases and qualifying long-term/current debt. No general cash-netting provision. Unconsummated acquisition debt exception applies only as defined.
EBITDA_basis: Trailing four-quarter contractual EBITDA, pro forma material acquisitions/dispositions; GAAP operating income plus specified nonduplicative adjustments. Not DCF EBIT, non-GAAP EPS, or cash balance.
cash_adjustment_caution: Cash payments for prior noncash addbacks reduce EBITDA; cash restructuring addback subject to 15% cap; noncash income subtracted; earnout and acquisition costs follow explicit provisions.
headroom_formula: max(0, min(1500 - existing revolver draw, 4 * contractual trailing EBITDA - other contractual debt - existing revolver draw))
threshold_qualification: Face debt proxy only, not compliance certificate. Additional counted debt and covenant adjustments change thresholds. Must also satisfy borrowing conditions/no default; historical compliance does not guarantee full availability.
